comment: Golden cases for tools/classify.py. Each observation is the evidence that was available BEFORE the solve, not a summary written afterwards — that is what makes this a measurement rather than a tautology. expect_top must be the first candidate; expect_within must appear in the first N. Add a case after every solve. Never delete one to make a change pass.
